notes.title: Winter is here, Bravelanders, and that means it’s time for a pre-holiday update

Winter is here, Bravelanders, and that means it’s time for a pre-holiday update:
[list]
[*] The way medals drop in online duels has changed. Medals now depend on the percentage of the army you’ve killed.
[*] The cooldown system has been revised when fighting storyline battles with clanmates — if you win, you can play further through the storyline without any cooldowns.
[*] You now lose less Fury if you get disconnected during a Boss Raid.
[*] Players with a Royal Blessing can now craft and disassemble multiple pieces of equipment and resources at once.
[*] The storyline has been improved. The difficulty of the first few chapters has been reduced. Storyline fury has been added. If you win frequently, your fury will increase, as will the number of enemies you face. Fury and enemy numbers will decrease again over time.
[*] Other corrections and improvements have been introduced.
[/list]
